prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: three-panel pixel-art storyboard for the Korean side-view game Last Bell, concept planning only. Create a wide horizontal triptych with exactly 3 equally sized panels separated by thin dark gutters, no lettering anywhere. Very low resolution aesthetic, deliberate large square pixels, no antialiasing, no glow blur, limited midnight navy, desaturated blue, old brass and pale gold palette. Left panel: a small hooded bell keeper with a short sword on the left faces right, a defeated taller floating bell-hatted ghost on the right breaks apart into square gold and navy fragments that fall downward, a few stone floor slabs at bottom 82% height, ruined arched gate in blue background. Center panel: a dark interior lobby slowly illuminated by one hanging bronze lantern, warm light in hard stepped concentric bands, the same little hooded bell keeper's idle silhouette emerges below the lantern, left quarter of the room is quiet dark negative space for a future character roster and right side has generous dark negative space for future stats; no actual UI or text. Right panel: imposing tall bell-helmet knight with a broken ring halo, long gold glaive, facing left, chest opens into a bright square core with two angular broken shockwave rings representing a roar; tiny hooded hero stands at left edge facing him. Background pillars stay dark, enemy silhouette has crisp readable golden armor. Mood: solemn, haunted, restrained and brave. Keep simple silhouettes and square debris, never gore, no game menus, no captions, no typography, no arrows, no glossy gradients or sci-fi holograms.
